description: JIVO OMS (Order Management System) CLI — READ-ONLY. Orders, quotations, schemes, approvals, party & product assignments, the SAP Business One mirror, live SAP HANA stock and pricing, the invoice review queue, FSSAI label compliance, and the invoice tracker at oms.jivo.in. Every command is a GET; no mutating endpoint is wrapped. HANA commands require --branch (OIL or BEVERAGE) — it picks the SAP company database.
